name: msb_first
why: data bits are sent most significant first instead of least significant first

name: stop_bit_low
why: the stop bit is driven low (framing error), the line only returns high at frame end

name: bit_period_one_long
why: every bit lasts CLKS_PER_BIT+1 clk cycles

name: parameter_ignored
why: hard-codes the default bit period of 16 cycles

name: idle_cycle_between_frames
why: tx_ready only when idle, so back-to-back frames gain one idle cycle

name: full_one_early
why: in_ready drops with DEPTH-1 bytes waiting, so the FIFO holds one byte too few

name: push_ignores_full
why: a byte offered while full is written anyway and overwrites the oldest waiting byte

name: pop_ignores_tx_ready
why: the FIFO pops whenever it is not empty, dropping bytes while a frame is in progress

name: reset_keeps_waiting_bytes
why: reset clears the pointers but not the waiting count, so stale bytes survive a reset

name: asynchronous_reset
why: an off-edge reset pulse aborts the frame in progress
replace: always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin // tx_fsm
